  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the full admin configuration object for a given merchant, including
programme settings, feature flags, and operational parameters set through the
Qubriux dashboard. Typically used during integration setup to verify merchant
configuration or to retrieve settings that drive client-side behaviour — for
example, determining which loyalty features are active. Requires the merchant ID
as a query parameter in addition to the standard API key in the request body.
